title: Grilled Steak Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish featuring grilled steak skewers, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe combines the richness of steak with the sweetness of juicy vegetables.

ingredients.name: juicy
ingredients.notes: bell pepper, onion, and cherry tomatoes

instructions: Cut the steak into 1-inch cubes and season with salt, pepper, and Dutch seasoning.
Thread the steak and juicy vegetables onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the steak reaches 135°F for medium-rare.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Sprinkle the nutty topping over the skewers before serving.
